info.title: TRUEOMX ESB Non-EJB Outbound Integration API
info.description:
Outbound REST and SOAP integration specification extracted from TIBCO OMX Order Management.

**Source folder**: `TRUEOMX_20250719 - AI`  
**Generated**: 2026-06-16  

**Scope**: Non-EJB outbound only — REST (85 services) + SOAP (173 services).  
EJB (CCBS-Client), JMS-Adapter, and JMS-Internal integrations are excluded.

**Endpoint resolution**: URLs are resolved from TIBCO global substitution variables (`*.substvar` files). Displayed URLs are UAT/default values.

**Total services**: 258
